1. Enable Kinetica in system keyboard list
Gestures you may not have found

Slide along the spacebar to move the cursor. Long-press a suggestion and slide up or down to change how strongly it is preferred. Dictionary → Import improved dictionary adds three to five times more words.
The word text and its badges scale with the bar, so a thinner bar means smaller text too
The grip strip above the suggestion bar. Turning it off reclaims 20dp; the keyboard can still be resized with the height slider above
Disables trails and effects to save battery
Languages the chord switch cycles through (order: English, Italiano, Español, Polski)
Hold ?123 and tap this letter to cycle enabled languages mid-typing
Turns off swipe typing, suggestions and autocorrect: every tap inserts its letter exactly. For slang and words the dictionary keeps correcting. The spacebar shows TAP while active
Hold ?123 and tap this letter to toggle peck-type mode from the keyboard
Swiped words decode against the active language and the first enabled non-active language, sharing one suggestion list. That other language is only offered first when it fits the gesture better.
Weight added when long-pressing a suggestion
Hold ?123 and tap a letter to insert its expansion
No chords assigned. The feature stays off until you add one.
Note: ?123+%1$s is reserved for the language cycle. This text chord will not fire while more than one language is enabled.
Note: ?123+%1$s is reserved for the peck-type toggle. This text chord will not fire.
Letter keys offer only digits and symbols. Ignored for a language whose own alphabet uses accents, such as Italian, Spanish or Polish
Prioritize numbers over accents on long-press
Long-press popups and key hints show the digit or symbol first instead of the accent
Base and personal dictionaries per language: info, import, export, reset
Remove the imported %1$s dictionary and revert to the bundled wordlist?
Delete the learned word \"%1$s\" and its weight? Typing it again will learn it back.
Delete all learned words and personal weights for %1$s? This cannot be undone.
Merged dictionary imported: %1$d new words added
Not an AOSP wordlist.combined file (no word entries found)
Not a Kinetica personal dictionary export
Import failed: could not read the file
Export failed: could not write the file
Merge adds the file\'s counts onto what is already learned. Replace deletes all learned words for this language first.

Improved dictionaries use the AOSP wordlist.combined format (e.g. main_en_US, main_it or main_pl from the Helium314/aosp-dictionaries mirror, Apache-2.0). The merge runs on-device against the bundled wordlist; abbreviations and offensive entries are dropped. Bigrams stay bundled.
Sliding left from backspace stages one letter at a time instead of one word. Nothing is deleted until you lift, and sliding back right still undoes it.
Swipe up on a top-row letter for its number, down on a bottom-row letter for its symbol. Your edge-swipe bindings take precedence.
Up to three symbols, space-separated (default \"? ! ,\"). The first sits above Enter and is inserted by a quick up-slide; slide left for the others.
Adds a narrow apostrophe key right of L, for writing contracted and elided words (don\'t, nell\'immagine) without the symbols layer.
Quick swipes on keys that insert text or open the emoji picker
Swipe across a key in the shown direction to fire its action.
No edge swipes bound. Add one or reset to defaults.
Replace all edge-swipe bindings with the original five defaults?
Makes the emoji picker the first long-press option on the comma key; X-key swipe-down always opens the picker
Keep the comma, remove it (spacebar widens), or repurpose it as a custom character, text, or editor action; the comma stays in the key\'s long-press popup when repurposed
Space-separated, up to eight. Leave blank to keep the built-in list
Used by the custom character and custom text options above
Preview — drag the hue above to change it
Preview — this palette ignores the hue; choose Custom colour above to use it
Colour wheel position, 0-360. Used when the theme above is set to a custom colour; every surface is derived from it
Primary color the palette is derived from (theme: custom)
